data.value: A Windows desktop edge panel tool — keep frequent actions at the screen edge, use them, then move on.

data.name: Ob_Welcome_Card1Text
data.value: Move the mouse to a screen edge or corner and the panel slides out; move away and it hides. Four edges + four corners = 16 trigger regions, each independently configurable.

data.name: Ob_Welcome_Card2Text
data.value: Panels only appear at the screen edges — nothing floats in the center: top/bottom edges = taskbar; left edge = widgets with the AI assistant mid-edge; right edge = widgets with the app assistant (picture-in-picture) mid-edge; four corners = quick toggles / recent items / notification dock (top-right is a safe zone by default).

data.name: Ob_Welcome_Tip
data.value: Privacy first: all data stays on your machine at %LOCALAPPDATA%\ShoreHue — no account, no ads, no cloud upload.

data.name: Ob_Map_CornersText

data.name: Ob_Map_Tip
data.value: The top-right corner is where window close buttons live, so it stays a safe zone by default — configure it as a window control center when you need it.

data.name: Ob_Taskbar_Desc
data.value: Top and bottom edges show the taskbar by default: your shortcuts on the left, running windows on the right.

data.name: Ob_Taskbar_Card1Text

data.name: Ob_Taskbar_Card2Text

data.name: Ob_Taskbar_Card3Text
data.value: Drag tabs to reorder; single-click a shortcut to launch (switches to it if already running). Running apps are highlighted in the taskbar.

data.name: Ob_Taskbar_Tip
data.value: The window list follows the system in real time (open/close/rename refresh instantly) — no manual refresh needed.

data.name: Ob_Pip_Card1Text

data.name: Ob_Widgets_Card2Text

data.value: Select text in any app and press this hotkey to open the panel and translate. Leave empty to disable.

data.name: Ob_Ai_Tip
data.value: Pro tip: "Output to cursor" — click the button, click a target window (e.g. Word), and AI replies are typed straight into your document. Requests go directly to your chosen provider, no middleman server.

data.name: Ob_Notify_Desc
data.value: Bottom-right aggregates notifications; bottom-left gets you back to recent work.

data.name: Ob_Notify_Card1Text
data.value: Captures system toasts and custom popups (WeChat/QQ etc.); click a notification to open its app; ✕ clears the list. New version releases also show up here — click to download and install.

data.name: Ob_Notify_Card2Text
data.value: Three tabs: recently opened files, recently used apps (foreground-window tracking), and favorite/recent web pages (reads Edge/Chrome history, with manual favorites).

data.name: Ob_Notify_Tip
data.value: Notification and recent data stay local — nothing is uploaded.

data.name: Ob_Customize_Desc
data.value: Every aspect of appearance and behavior is adjustable, applied instantly.

data.name: Ob_Customize_Card1Text
data.value: Background/text colors, opacity, corner radius, a custom icon and the global font scale — all in Settings → Panel → Appearance; Mica backdrop is enabled automatically on Win11 22H2+.

data.name: Ob_Customize_Card2Text
data.value: Show/hide animation, easing, duration and panel frame rate are adjustable in Settings → Animations; three performance presets (Smooth/Normal/Power Saver) switch in one click from the quick-toggles panel — Power Saver disables animation for minimal CPU.

data.name: Ob_Customize_Card3Text
data.value: Each edge can follow the mouse or stay fixed; "Tide-follow" mode lets the panel follow your cursor around; on multiple monitors the panel follows the screen the mouse is on.

data.name: Ob_Customize_Tip
data.value: All 16 regions' panel type, shape and trigger delay are individually configurable — e.g. turn the right edge into the AI assistant, or the top-right corner into a window control center.

data.name: Ob_Customize_Card4Title
data.value: Seabed: settings and features are files

data.name: Ob_Customize_Card4Text
data.value: Turn on "Programming mode (Seabed)" in Settings → General and the window gains a "Seabed" tab: every setting is organized under General / Region / Panel / Animations as real folders and JSON files, and widget code lives in "Panel/Widgets" where you can edit it directly — save and it takes effect instantly. Settings itself becomes a visual file explorer: what you see in the tree is what is in the folder.

data.name: Ob_Map_RingTitle
data.value: No mouse? Try the number ring (modifier + 1-9)

data.name: Ob_Map_RingText
data.value: After enabling "Keyboard summon region panels" in Settings → Region → Advanced, press the modifier (Ctrl by default; switch to Ctrl+Shift / Alt / Ctrl+Alt to avoid browser conflicts) + a number key to summon the matching region: 7/9/1/3 = corners, 2/4/6/8 = mid-edges. Both the top-row and numpad digits work; press again to dismiss; Ctrl+9 (top-right) stays a safe zone by default.

data.name: Ob_Done_Hotkey3DescSet
data.value: Number ring: press 1-9 to summon the matching region panel (top-row or numpad; press again to dismiss)

data.name: Ob_Done_Hotkey3DescUnset
data.value: Number ring is off — enable "Keyboard summon region panels" in Settings → Region → Advanced to use it

data.name: Ob_Done_Sub
data.value: Move the mouse to a screen edge and give it a try! Everything is adjustable in Settings, and you can reopen this guide anytime.

data.name: Ob_Done_Hotkey2UnsetDesc
data.value: No selection-translation hotkey yet — configure it in Settings or step 7 of this guide.

data.name: Ob_Done_Hotkey2SetDesc
data.value: Translate selected text in any app

data.name: Ob_Map_CustomText
data.value: All 16 regions — trigger on/off, panel type (taskbar/widgets/AI/PiP/notifications…), shape (square/horizontal/vertical strip), size and trigger delay — can be configured individually in Settings → Region. Turn any edge or corner into whatever you want.

data.name: Ob_Done_Tip
data.value: Tip: just move the mouse to a screen edge or corner to trigger panels — no buttons to click.

data.name: Ob_Map_CornerTR
data.value: Top-right: safe zone by default (no panel, keeps close button clear)

data.name: Set_PassthroughTip
data.value: Hold this key while clicking to pass clicks through the panel to content underneath (the panel follows the mouse; use this to interact with content it covers)

data.name: Set_StabilizeTip
data.value: On content switch the main icon centers and content loads silently; after this hold time without new switches, the icon returns and content fades from ghost to solid. Rapid consecutive switches reset the timer

data.name: Set_SnapRangeTip
data.value: Snaps the panel to a screen edge when its edge is within this distance (0 disables). Snap animation duration follows fly duration

data.name: Jump_ToggleDndDesc
data.value: Turn Do Not Disturb mode on or off

data.name: Jump_TogglePanelDesc
data.value: Immediately show or hide the edge panel

data.name: Set_PanelFrameRateTip
data.value: Rendering frame rate for panel follow / tide-follow animation. Higher = smoother, lower = less CPU.

data.name: Set_PanelFrameRateSliderTip
data.value: 0 = Auto (follows display refresh rate). Manual options: 30 / 60 / 90 / 120 fps.

data.name: Set_PanelFrameRateHint
data.value: Higher frame rate makes edge follow and tide-follow mode smoother (Smooth mode recommends 60-120); lower saves CPU (Power Saver auto-lowers).

data.name: Set_WebTool_Desc
data.value: The "Web Tools" tab in the widget panel opens the selected tool page via WebView2. Pick a default, or enter any URL.
